reviews.comment: All the reviews are true. (except the positive one). Copies directly from his paper of notes onto the board and makes many mistakes. Notes slides provided sometimes don't match the notes in class. Entire grade is only tests, quizzes, and exams. 5 question exams 3-4 question quizzes all free response. Take anyone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the hardest class I have ever taken in my college career and you could not pay me to take it again. I hated every single second of this course and the tests were so bad you had to either laugh or cry. I don't know how I managed to pull out a C but I'm just glad it's over. He was a nice guy but the subject was just the WORST.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you don't have to. Professor Schweitkert is a nice guy but a horrible professor. His lectures were just a series of practice problems taken from the book, done way too fast and with calculation errors. You get a cheat sheet for tests and quizzes but it was just dumb luck on whether or not you wrote down the right things.

I do not understand the other reviews stating that Dr.Schweikert is rude. He is always willing to help with any questions & does not think any questions are "stupid". You get what you put in, so study! He holds help sessions that are very helpful. He's lenient and forgiving with grading. Not the best lecturer but still teaches with passion!

He copies his notes directly from his paper to the blackboard without any context, does not work out the math, skips steps, he sometimes can't even follow his own notes because he is not solving the problem, he is just mimicking his notes. going to lecture was pointless. no partial credit. you have to teach yourself. Get another prof for this class
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Impossible to get in contact with, says he gives partial credit but when you look at exams and quizzes he will miss a lot of it. Doesn't seem to care about the students, works half of problems and assumes you know how to complete the rest. Worst prof i've ever had.
Truly the worst prof I've ever had. he is horrible at explaining and is rude. I would love to say take this class with a different prof but hes the only one

Absolutely the worst Professor I have ever had. He is rude to his students and If you ask questions he makes you feel stupid for not knowing the answer. He also has an extremely high drop rate and does not care about his student failing.

He does not enjoy teaching this class and it's very apparent. His slides are screenshots of the textbook and rather than explaining the examples, he just writes down the solutions. These solutions are exactly what is given in the textbook so you have to teach yourself. Most skip lecture and just read the textbook instead.

Dr. Schweikert is probably one of the worst chem profs I've ever had. He genuinely does not care if you pass or fail, will not curve, and doesn't give any partial credit (unless you're remarkably lucky). Would say to take a different prof, but sadly he's the only one who teaches this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most of the time you attend class he goes over some problems and doesn't even fully solve them. Another issue is he will miscalculate things and students have to correct him. Possibly the worst prof i've had, you have to teach yourself with the book or you will not pass.

One of the worst professors yet. He has an attitude and the way he goes about grading things is horrific. Says he gives partial credit but honestly doesnt. The simplest mistake will cause you to loose all points on a question. This is brutal as the exams are free response and only one and the final will count. Unfortunate that hes the only prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Schweikert works a lot of examples, yet somehow you just cannot solve questions in homework, quizzes, or exams. He gives review sessions too, which are very helpful. He gives partial credit, but It is difficult to even get them. So, most of the times you get either full points or no points, which doesnt help at all.

Schweikert is an average professor; not bad, but not good. As long as you try in his class you'll be fine, and he'll notice your effort. Make sure you get the textbook; most exam, quiz, and HW problems are heavily based off the textbook. Work through example problems in the book along w/ HW and quiz problems and you'll be ready for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers
